name: BinCoin Boot Disks
description: 1,000 floppy disks launch BinCoin, the mining game on Robinhood Chain. Mint up to 2 per wallet. Insert a disk in the dApp: it is burned and a Genesis Miner (200 H/s) is born from it, with the disk's number. Your first disk joins the game with no fee and gives you the Genesis rank. Mining starts 24 hours after the last disk. OpenSea keeps 10% of the mint; everything else opens the BIN market on Genesis Day, with burned liquidity. Robinoshi takes nothing.
